topic: Mother Carmel's real name was Mountain Witch, and the Sheep's House was a front for trafficking orphans directly to the World Government—including Big Mom herself
title: Mother Carmel Was Actually A Trafficker
description: The woman Big Mom called her mother for years was secretly known as Mountain Witch in the underworld. The Sheep's House wasn't a charity—it was a trafficking operation. She had already sold orphans to the World Government before Linlin arrived, and she planned to sell Linlin too.
comment: Did Mother Carmel ever actually care about those children, or was it all an act from the very beginning?

lines.text: Mother Carmel's real name in the underworld was Mountain Witch, and the Sheep's House was never a charity at all.
She'd been recruiting orphans for years, building trust with every kindness, just to sell them to the World Government for profit.
The first giant the Marines ever enlisted came directly from her. She had already established that business model.

shot.fallback: earlier victim of her trafficking scheme

lines.text: Every warm memory Big Mom has of Carmel happened while Carmel was already planning to sell her for profit.
The kindness was real. The mercy was real. But it was all packaging for a much darker transaction underneath.
She'd planned her own retirement around that sale, getting rich off one last transaction before disappearing completely.
The woman Big Mom still carries a portrait of was never the mother who chose her. She was just the first trafficker.
That portrait is why Big Mom still can't accept being abandoned, because the one woman who 'chose' her only chose profit...

shot.search: Portrait why Big Mom can't accept
shot.fallback: lasting pain from a calculated betrayal

self_check.hook: lines 1-2 establish Carmel's true identity and operation, line 4 makes the betrayal personal
self_check.loop: last line returns to the portrait (from line 7) as the source of Big Mom's unresolved wound
